item.title: Clear Path 465 project nearly complete; expected to be done by summer
item.description: This summer, the sight of orange cones may be a thing of the past for drivers on Indy's northeast side. Drivers have been frustrated and have grown tired of all the construction on 465. That is expected to change by the summer.
